headline: EPS ticks higher year-over-year
summary_short: Computer Age Management Services reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₹5.14, up 16.4% y/y and 0.8% q/q.
summary_long: EPS of ₹5.14 rose 16.4% year-over-year from ₹4.414 and was roughly flat sequentially (+0.8%) versus ₹5.10 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
